title: Locomo-Plus: Beyond-Factual Cognitive Memory Evaluation Framework for LLM Agents
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark for evaluating cognitive memory in LLMs, focusing on consistency with latent constraints such as a user's stated goals, state, or personal values (e.g., valuing team well-being over profit). It does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, broader moral systems, or ethical frameworks.
